Ava (CEO): Quick heads up — All-hands tomorrow 10:00am PT. Agenda below. Please drop any questions in thread or use the form. Zoom: https://zoom.redwood/ah-0312

Agenda:
- Exec update (Ava) — 10m
- Product roadmap highlights (Nate) — 15m
- Dedicated & Private GA callouts + pricing note (María) — 10m
- Policy update: travel & expense changes (Ravi) — 5m
- Q&A + lightning wins — 20m

Pre-read deck: https://drive.redwood/allhands/mar-2026-deck.pdf
If you can’t make it, react with :calendar: and we’ll surface questions during the meeting.

Nate (Product): I'll drop 2 demo links in the pre-read to call out latency improvements.

Ravi (People Ops): FYI — policy update is limited to corporate travel & expense submission window (effective next month). TL;DR: receipts via mobile app only, per diem update. We'll post an FAQ after the meeting.

María (Eng): Can we add a 2-min note about Dedicated autoscaling changes? tiny risk to rolling deploys.

Sam (SRE): timing OK. Also reminder: office snack run after for those on-site :coffee: 

Jon (Eng): Quick question — will the recording include captions?

Ava (CEO): Yes — captions + transcript. We'll post recording link in this thread.

Ravi (People Ops): If you have private HR questions, DM me directly. For policy Qs, drop them here so we can answer in the all-hands.

Devon (Finance): submitting a Q: will parental leave policy extension pilot be permanent?

Ravi (People Ops): Good Q, we'll cover the pilot status in the policy slide.

(all-hands-bot): 2026-03-12 11:36am: Recording posted — https://recordings.redwood/ah-2026-03-12

Ava (CEO): Thanks everyone — top takeaways:
1) Dedicated GA next quarter with price tiers — details in console next week.
2) Travel policy: switch to mobile receipts, staggered per diem change, FAQ in People Ops.
3) Continued focus on latency/cost tradeoffs — product demos showed 18% token-cost reduction on common workloads.

Nate (Product): Recording timestamp for the demo: 00:07:20 — 00:22:45

María (Eng): Note — rollout of autoscaling guardrails starts Mon. We'll notify impacted teams via eng-platform.

Ravi (People Ops): FAQ link: https://intra.redwood/people/travel-policy-march2026

Sam (SRE): tiny ops follow-up: dataset rollout caused brief spike, mitigated by prefix cache tweak — full postmortem in incident channel.

Ava (CEO): Appreciate the turnout. If you asked a question live and we didn't answer it, leave a reply here and we'll follow up.

(all-hands-bot): Poll — Was the all-hands useful? :thumbsup: / :thumbsdown: (react on the message)
